Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Μαΐου, «Προφήτης Ιερεμίας», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 1. мај ст. ст., „Свети пророк Јеремија.“, with Свети left off as no rank and пророк left off as the `prophet` this folder already carries in `types` and `honorific.js` composes back. The heading offers no epithet and no patronymic, so the bare forename is the whole of the Serbian form; Anathoth and the priest Helkias are the body's and the other calendars', and this corpus keeps neither in a name form. Two other folders already hold the same bare form; the fold was measured and the row is in the batch's commit message.

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαΐου — «Προφήτης Ιερεμίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is plainly the same prophet: son of the priest Chelkias, of Anathoth in Benjamin north-east of Jerusalem, called at twenty-three to twenty-five years old, stoned by his own countrymen at Taphnas in Egypt. **The Greek adds a year of birth the folder did not have**: «Ο Προφήτης Ιερεμίας γεννήθηκε πιθανώς κατά το 650 π.Χ.», and the page heads him «(-650 - ;)»; that year is now in `dates`, with the page's own «πιθανώς» kept in the note. It prints no year for his death and offers two ends in the alternative — stoned at Taphnas, «ή απήχθη μαζί με τον Βαρούχ αιχμάλωτος από τον βασιλέα Ναβουχοδονόσωρ σε κάποια εισβολή του στην Αίγυπτο το 568 π.Χ., ως λέγει κάποια Ραββινική παράδοση» — so no year of death is recorded from it. It divides his public work into four periods under Josiah, Jehoiakim and Zedekiah and after the fall of Jerusalem, and it records where his synaxis was kept: «Η Σύναξη αυτού ετελείτο στο ναό του Αποστόλου Πέτρου, που ήταν κοντά στην Μεγάλη Εκκλησία». **Of the page's two apolytikia one is stored and one is not**: the Ἦχος α’ «Ἐκ γαστρὸς ἠγιάσθης» is proper and names him, and is stored here; the short Ἦχος β’ «Τοῦ προφήτου σου Ἰερεμίου τὴν μνήμην, Κύριε, ἑορτάζοντες» is the common of a prophet with his name set into it and was left. The page also links a «Διήγησις εις τον θρήνον του Προφήτου Ιερεμίου», which is a narrative and not a folder. The folder already carries a Romanian troparion; the Greek apolytikion is a different text and not a translation of it.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.05.2026 (1. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети пророк Јеремија.“

attestations.note: **The day is Julian 1 May, the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek keep him on.** This is the third account read for this folder and it is the longest of the three, with **six things neither of the other two tells**: the prophecy against Јоаким that „ће његов погреб бити као погреб магарца“, cast out dead beyond Jerusalem and dragged long on the ground unburied, **and that it was for this prophecy that he was thrown into prison**; that unable to write there he called Baruch, who „стаде код прозорчића тамнице“, stood at the prison's little window while he dictated; the word to Јехонија that he would be carried to Babylon with his whole family and die there; the letter to the captives telling them not to hope for a return, „јер ће остати у Вавилону седамдесет година“; the sound pot broken before the people in the valley of Тотеф, where the Jews had offered their children to the idols, and the enormous number of Jews cut down in that same valley when the city fell; and **the fire out of the temple hidden in a deep well**, beside the ark hidden in a cave on Mount Nebo. It also has him foretell to the Egyptians „сокрушење њихових идола и долазак у Мисир Дјеве са Младенцем“ — the coming into Egypt of the Virgin with the Child — and preserves a tradition that **Alexander himself visited the prophet's grave** and that the body was carried to Alexandria by his order, where the Romanian life has only the later translation. **A birth widened and neither reading chosen**: „Рођен на шест стотина година пре Христа“ against saint.gr's «πιθανώς κατά το 650 π.Χ.», so `birth` is now −650 to −600 and reads „650 or 600 BC“. **No death year was added**: this book gives the four years in Egypt and the stoning with no year, as the other two do. **One slip of the book is recorded and not corrected**: the vessel broken in the valley is „лонац“, a pot, in the sentence that breaks it and „ланац“, a chain, in the sentence that recalls it four lines later — the same object under two words, and a copied source is not corrected by a reader. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; doxologia's troparion for him is already on this folder from the Romanian reading.

hymns.text: A prorocului Tău, Doamne, Ieremia pomenire prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm, mântuieşte sufletele noastre.

english.text: Keeping the memory of thy prophet Jeremiah, O Lord, we entreat thee through him: save our souls.

hymns.text: Ἐκ γαστρὸς ἠγιάσθης τὴ προγνώσει τοῦ Κτίσαντος, καὶ προφητικῆς ἐπληρώθης ἐκ σπαργάνων συνέσεως, ἐθρήνησας τὴν πτῶσιν Ἰσραήλ, σοφὲ Ἱερεμία ἐν στοργῇ, διὰ τοῦτο ὡς Προφήτην καὶ Ἀθλητήν, τιμῶμεν σὲ κραυγάζοντες, δόξα τῷ σὲ δοξάσαντι Χριστῷ, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ χορηγούντι διὰ σοῦ, ἠμὶν τὰ κρείττονα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης, on the page of «Προφήτης Ιερεμίας»

english.text: From the womb wast thou sanctified by the foreknowledge of the Creator, and from thy swaddling clothes wast thou filled with prophetic understanding; thou didst lament the fall of Israel in love, O wise Jeremiah. Therefore we honour thee as prophet and contender, and cry: Glory to Christ who glorified thee, glory to Him who crowned thee, glory to Him who through thee bestows better things upon us.

birth.note: The Охридски пролог for 1. мај ст. ст. opens „Рођен на шест стотина година пре Христа у селу Анатоту, недалеко од Јерусалима.“ — six hundred years before Christ — where saint.gr has «Ο Προφήτης Ιερεμίας γεννήθηκε πιθανώς κατά το 650 π.Χ., στην μικρή πόλη της φυλής Βενιαμίν Αναθώθ» and heads him «(-650 - ;)». Two sources fifty years apart, both of them round numbers and one of them hedged; neither was chosen and the interval carries both. The Greek page's «πιθανώς», which this folder's display used to carry as „c.“, is recorded here instead: `node .tmp/dd.mjs` reads „650 or 600 BC“ in both packs — «650 или 600 до Р. Х.» and «650 ή 600 π.Χ.» — and reads neither „c. 650 BC or 600 BC“ nor „650 BC or 600 BC“ at all, so the hedge could not stay in the display. No year of death is printed on any of the three pages: this book gives four years in Egypt and a stoning with no year, doxologia gives none for any of it, and saint.gr offers the stoning at Taphnas or captivity with Baruch in 568 BC in the alternative.
